Concretely for n=1 the two sums are a1, a2 with a1+a2=1; taking (0.9, 0.1) the only gap is 0.8 > 1/3, so the displayed bound (11) fails. The correct pigeonhole must include the sums 0 and 1 (2^{n+1} points, 2^{n+1}-1 gaps summing to exactly 1); the write-up's later case analysis already covers A or B empty, so a one-sentence edit repairs it.
